scope: Post-hoc saved-trajectory mechanism audit. Immediate comparisons use the same corrected tracker history, comparing the clipped no-offset and clipped offset boxes from one raw prediction. Closed-loop state slices include all prior crop/template effects. Template write counts do not isolate a causal template mechanism. GT is evaluation-only.
